title: CSV export for Lists
summary: Export the entries of any List to CSV. Click Export in the list toolbar and download your data. For larger lists the export runs in the background - you'll receive an email with a download link when it's ready.
body_markdown:
[Back to All](https://docs.castle.io/changelog)


Added


Export the entries of any List to CSV. Click **Export** in the list toolbar and download your data.


For larger lists the export runs in the background - you'll receive an email with a download link when it's ready.
